title: Kusalarāsi
text: 2. Kusalarāsī ti bhikkhave vadamāno cattāro satipaṭṭhāne sammāvadamāno vadeyya || || Kevalo hāyam bhikkhave kusalarāsī yad idaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā || katame cattāro || || [page 187] Saṃyutta-Nikāya. 187 3. Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati || Vedanāsu || Citte || Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || 4. Kusalarāsī ti bhikkhave vadamāno ime cattāro satipaṭṭhāne sammāvadamāno vadeyya || || Kevalo hāyam bhikkhave kusalarāsī yad idaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā ti || ||
